scope.summary: Synchronously retire frontend generic command write APIs (POST /bff/actions/... and POST /api/v1/operator/commands) while retaining canonical POST /bff/v1/commands, GET /bff/actions catalog, and GET /api/v1/operator/commands/{id} status polling. Re-wire Persona operations (run_eval, restrict_tools, suspend, retire) to canonical commands client and consume server confirmation expiry directly without client-side TTL.

ppl_alloc_007_provenance_hold.note: Verified PPL-ALLOC-007 has no active worker or lease and its provenance hold is respected.

retired_generic_write_routes.note: Removed from seed taxonomy live mutations and writes.ts legacy-actions route branch; ActionDescriptors repointed to /bff/v1/commands.
Retired generic operator write endpoint; zero callers in execute-plans.

preserved_routes.purpose: Sole canonical generic command write route

modified_files.description: Mark paths.action as deprecated with warning pointing to POST /bff/v1/commands; add actionCatalog and actions path builders for GET /bff/actions.

Retire legacy-actions route branch in runAction; delegate exclusively to canonical runCommandAction (/bff/v1/commands); consume server-issued expiresAt directly in requestConfirmToken and readConfirmToken.
Re-wire runPersonaAction directly to runAction with kind 'Persona', routing all persona actions to canonical POST /bff/v1/commands via PersonaAction envelope.

Remove obsolete legacy-actions test; add tests verifying all four Persona actions (run_eval, restrict_tools, suspend, retire) post to /bff/v1/commands with PersonaAction envelope; verify requestConfirmToken uses server-issued expiresAt.
Update test expectation to assert env.data.expiresAt matches server-provided expiresAt directly.
Update canonicalActionEndpoint and test assertions to project ActionDescriptor endpoints to canonical /bff/v1/commands path.
Update allowedActions endpoints to /bff/v1/commands; update fetch-071 through fetch-075 paths and bodies to canonical /bff/v1/commands with PersonaAction envelopes; update fixture router.
Add test assertions for runPersonaAction operations executing run_eval, restrict_tools, suspend, and retire via canonical /bff/v1/commands.
Add test asserting that HighRiskConfirm honors server-issued expiresAt directly for TTL calculation without adding client-side TTL.
